input.quote: ARTICLE IV TERM I Subject to termination pursuant to this Agreement, the Non Exclusive license granted by Licensor to Licensee shall be for an initial period of 36 months, commencing from the acceptance date, (the "Initial Period"). The Agreement may be renewed for an additional period of seven (7) years at the option of the Licensor.
input.rationale: The Agreement commits Licensee to a 36-month Initial Period (renewable at Licensor's option) and the only termination rights anywhere in the document are for cause or upon defined events: Licensor's immediate termination for any Licensee breach (Art. IV, Art. II/p0043), mutual insolvency termination (Art. XIX), automatic termination on a Licensee Change of Control and Licensor termination on Licensee wind-up (Art. XX), with Art. XXI/XXIII addressing only the effects of termination. There is no Licensee right to terminate for convenience on any notice period, which falls below both the preferred (30 days' notice with pro-rata refund) and fallback (60-90 days' notice, fee capped at 3 months) positions and is walk-away territory for a multi-year term. On the other side, Licensor has no convenience right, which is consistent with the playbook, so our redline only adds the Licensee exit and confirms the position for Licensor.

ops.text: IV Licensee may terminate this Agreement for convenience, in whole or in part, at any time upon thirty (30) days' prior written notice to Licensor, without penalty, early termination charge or further liability for fees accruing after the effective date of termination, in which case Licensor shall refund to Licensee any prepaid fees covering the period after the effective date of such termination. Licensor shall have no right to terminate this Agreement for convenience during the Initial Period or any extension or renewal thereof.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a Licensee right to terminate for convenience on thirty (30) days' written notice with a refund of prepaid fees, because the Agreement locks us into a 36-month term with no exit other than for cause; our playbook does not accept a multi-year commitment without a convenience right. We can discuss 60-90 days' notice as a fallback.
proposal.summary: Add Licensee termination for convenience on 30 days' notice with refund of prepaid fees, and confirm Licensor has no convenience right during the term.
